notes.zh: 每节课 ≥ 50% 时间以游戏形式进行（L1–L3）。
notes.en: ≥ 50% of each session is game-based (L1–L3).

notes.zh: 8 岁以下建议使用短柄拍（53–58cm）、低网（1.3–1.4m）、迷你场地。
notes.en: Under 8: short racket (53–58cm), lower net (1.3–1.4m), mini court.

notes.zh: L1–L3 不做杀球大力量专项，不做负重训练。
notes.en: No heavy smash or weighted strength work at L1–L3.

notes.zh: 用徽章、星星卡、闯关等方式激励。
notes.en: Motivate with badges, star cards and "quest" challenges.

notes.zh: 每 8 周给家长一次书面反馈。
notes.en: Written parent feedback every 8 weeks.

goal.zh: 喜欢羽毛球，建立手眼协调和基本移动能力。
goal.en: Enjoy badminton; build hand-eye coordination and basic movement.

quest.zh: 颠球 10 次 + 发球过网 5/10 + 与教练连续对打 5 拍。
quest.en: Keep-ups ×10 + serve over net 5/10 + 5-shot rally with coach.

goal.zh: 能与同伴连续对打，认识基本球路和场地。
goal.en: Rally with a partner; learn basic shots and court lines.

quest.zh: 与同伴连续对拉 15 拍；高远发球进后场 6/10。
quest.en: 15-shot rally with a peer; high serve to rear court 6/10.

goal.zh: 动作基本规范，能打满后场，懂计分，开始打比赛。
goal.en: Correct basic technique, clear to baseline, know scoring, start playing matches.

quest.zh: 打一场 11 分正式比赛并独立计分；高远球到底线 1/3 7/10。
quest.en: Play an 11-point match with self-scoring; clear to rear third 7/10.

goal.zh: 四方球稳定，掌握头顶与反手过渡，有初步战术。
goal.en: Consistent 4-corner game, round-the-head & backhand, basic tactics.

quest.zh: 四方步法多球 20 球；参加一次俱乐部内部赛。
quest.en: 4-corner multi-feed 20 shuttles; play one in-club tournament.

goal.zh: 有进攻武器，能打对抗，开始参加地区比赛。
goal.en: Have attacking weapons; play under pressure; enter local competitions.

quest.zh: 参加一次地区青少年比赛，赛后与教练一起写出 2 个对手弱点。
quest.en: Play one local junior event and write down 2 opponent weaknesses with your coach.

goal.zh: 全面技术 + 稳定战术 + 系统体能，冲击省市级比赛。
goal.en: Complete technique, consistent tactics, structured fitness; target provincial events.

quest.zh: 完成一次赛前计划 + 视频复盘，并在省市级比赛中执行。
quest.en: Write a game plan, play it in a regional event, and review the video.

notes.zh: 成人常见问题是"野路子"动作，**纠错优先于加新技术**。
notes.en: Adults often have self-taught habits — **correction comes before new skills**.

notes.zh: 每节课包含 10–15 分钟热身（动态拉伸、肩袖激活）。
notes.en: Every session has 10–15 min warm-up (dynamic stretching, rotator-cuff activation).

notes.zh: 重点防伤部位：**肩、肘（网球肘）、膝、跟腱、腰**。
notes.en: Injury focus: **shoulder, elbow, knee, Achilles, lower back**.

notes.zh: 40 岁以上学员：起跳、急停类训练量减半，增加恢复。
notes.en: 40+: halve jump/stop-start volume, add recovery time.

notes.zh: 用视频对比（入学 vs 每 8 周）帮助成人看到进步。
notes.en: Use video comparison (intake vs every 8 weeks) to show progress.

goal.zh: 正确握拍和基本击球框架，能简单对打。
goal.en: Correct grip and basic stroke shape; simple rallies.

goal.zh: 纠正错误动作，掌握基本球路，认识单打规则。
goal.en: Fix bad habits, learn basic shots, know singles rules.

goal.zh: 规范步法，后场技术成套，能打完整比赛。
goal.en: Structured footwork, full rear-court set, play full matches.

goal.zh: 四方球稳定、反手可用、能打攻防转换。
goal.en: Consistent 4-corner game, usable backhand, attack-defence transitions.

goal.zh: 有得分手段和比赛计划，参加地区业余比赛。
goal.en: Point-winning weapons and game plans; local amateur competition.

goal.zh: 全面技术、稳定战术与系统体能，能参加高水平业余比赛。
goal.en: Complete technique, consistent tactics and structured fitness for top amateur events.

notes.zh: L1–L3 以"合作得分"游戏为主，如两人合作连续击球计数。
notes.en: L1–L3 focus on cooperative games, e.g. partner rally counts.

notes.zh: 每次课**轮换搭档**，培养与不同人配合和社交能力。
notes.en: **Rotate partners** every session to build adaptability and social skills.

notes.zh: L4 之前前后场都要练，不固定分工。
notes.en: No fixed front/rear roles before L4.

notes.zh: 强调礼貌与鼓励：失误后击掌、说"没关系 / Nice try"。
notes.en: Emphasise respect: high-five and say "没关系 / Nice try" after errors.

notes.zh: L1–L3 不做混双分工训练。
notes.en: No mixed-doubles role training at L1–L3.

goal.zh: 喜欢和同伴一起打球，学会轮流和沟通。
goal.en: Enjoy playing with a partner; learn to take turns and communicate.

quest.zh: 与同伴合作连续击球 10 拍；游戏中每球都喊口令。
quest.en: 10-shot cooperative rally with a partner; call every shuttle in a game.

goal.zh: 知道双打规则与场地，会基本站位。
goal.en: Know doubles rules and court; basic positioning.

quest.zh: 打一局 7 分双打，发球站位全对；网前发球 6/10。
quest.en: Play a 7-point doubles game with correct serving positions; low serve 6/10.

goal.zh: 会"进攻前后、防守左右"，会双打计分与轮换。
goal.en: "Front-back to attack, side-by-side to defend"; doubles scoring and service order.

quest.zh: 打一场 11 分双打，独立计分且无发球顺序错误。
quest.en: 11-point doubles match, self-scored with no service-order errors.

goal.zh: 攻守转换和轮转，开始尝试主动进攻。
goal.en: Attack-defence transitions and rotation; start attacking deliberately.

quest.zh: 与 2 位不同搭档各打一场 11 分比赛，全程有口令、无站位混乱。
quest.en: Play an 11-point match with each of 2 partners, calling every shuttle with no position clashes.

goal.zh: 前后场有分工，有发接发套路，参加地区比赛。
goal.en: Clear front/rear roles, serve-return plays; local competition.

quest.zh: 与固定搭档参加一次地区双打比赛，执行 1 套发接发套路。
quest.en: Enter a local doubles event with a regular partner and use one serve-return play.

goal.zh: 高速轮转、连续进攻与高质量防守，冲击省市级双打比赛。
goal.en: High-speed rotation, attack chains and strong defence for provincial doubles events.

quest.zh: 组合写出赛前计划并在省市级比赛中执行，赛后一起复盘。
quest.en: Write a pair game plan, play it at a provincial event, and review it together.

notes.zh: 成人业余球员大多以双打为主，可作为主线框架。
notes.en: Most adult amateurs mainly play doubles; this can be their main track.

notes.zh: 常见问题：两人站一起、乱起高球、中路让球 —— **先纠站位再练技术**。
notes.en: Common issues: standing together, needless lifts, leaving middle shuttles — **fix positioning before technique**.

notes.zh: 平抽、封网、急停较多，注意**肩、肘、膝、跟腱**。
notes.en: Lots of drives, interceptions and sudden stops — watch **shoulder, elbow, knee, Achilles**.

notes.zh: L5 起可选**混双模块**。
notes.en: Optional **mixed doubles module** from L5.

notes.zh: 40 岁以上：减少连续杀球和高强度多球组数。
notes.en: 40+: reduce repeated-smash and high-intensity multi-feed sets.

goal.zh: 认识双打场地与规则，能在双打中参与对打。
goal.en: Know doubles court and rules; take part in doubles rallies.

goal.zh: 改掉"两人站一起"，学会基本前后/左右站位。
goal.en: Stop "standing together"; learn front-back and side-by-side.

goal.zh: 主动下压意识，能接杀，能打完整双打比赛。
goal.en: "Keep it down" mindset, defend smashes, play full doubles matches.

goal.zh: 流畅轮转，主动抢攻，有基本战术。
goal.en: Smooth rotation, take the attack, basic tactics.

goal.zh: 前后场分工清楚，有发接发套路，参加地区业余双打比赛。
goal.en: Clear front/rear roles and serve-return plays; enter local amateur doubles events.

goal.zh: 高速轮转与连续进攻，组合有针对性战术和复盘习惯。
goal.en: High-speed rotation and attack chains, with opponent-specific plans and regular review.
